name: input-embedding-failure-fails-open
note: the input embedding fails, so the classifier reports failure; with no on_error set that is match_false, so the rule misses and the trace entry carries no score

name: zero-vector-input-fails-open
note: a zero-length input vector has no direction, so the cosine is undefined and the classifier fails; match_false routes to default_model and the trace entry carries no score

name: dimension-mismatch-fails-open
note: an input vector of a different length than the phrase vectors cannot be compared, so the cosine is undefined and the classifier fails; match_false routes to default_model and the trace entry carries no score
